name: Logo Library
description: Assign channel logos from a catalog (like the tv-logo/tv-logos repo) using manual mappings or group-based automatic matching.
author: sethwv

actions.label: Manual Match
actions.description: Apply saved channel mappings and replace existing channel logos.

actions.label: Auto Match
actions.description: Match and assign logos for configured groups using saved settings.

actions.label: Ignore skipped and failed channels
actions.description: Add skipped and failed channels from the latest Auto Match to the ignore list.
